en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a Protestant-style church, showing rows of wooden pews leading up to an apse with an altar rail, altar table, large hanging chandeliers, and three tall arched windows with stained glass. A raised pulpit with a canopy stands on the left wall, hymn boards hang on both sides, and flower arrangements and candlesticks decorate the altar area. At the bottom right, printing indicates a photo credit and publisher information.
